run_ml_inference_her: run the ml_inference script to perform HER voltage prediction using computational and experimental CSV data
run_volcano_plot_pca: run the ml_inference script to generate a volcano plot using PCA on adsorbate mean energies
run_parity_plot_cv: run the ml_inference script with cv_results_csv to generate a parity plot of experimental vs predicted voltage
get_computational_df_to_predict: get aggregate energies per bulk material from a computational CSV or parquet file for inference
refactor_ml_inference_features: refactor the ml_inference script to add or remove elemental features from the linear regression model
